title: Patriots 53-man roster projection 1.0: Will New England really stick with 7 receivers?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots face decisions on wide receivers, with Kayshon Boutte's roster spot uncertain amid trade possibilities.
New England may keep three quarterbacks, including rookie Behren Morton, to develop as a backup.
Rhamondre Stevenson, TreVeyon Henderson, and Terrell Jennings projected as Patriots' running backs.

title: Adley Rutschman could make his Red Sox debut in coming days
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman, recently acquired by the Red Sox, may debut in the series against the Blue Jays in Toronto.
Rutschman, 28, played two rehab games with Triple-A Worcester following wrist inflammation, showing promising performance.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy confirmed Rutschman will not play Monday but may be activated later in the Toronto series.

title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Governor Maura Healey signed a bill allowing the state to seize Norwood Hospital through eminent domain.
The 11-acre property may be leased to a nonprofit to complete stalled construction after 2020 flood damage.
Norwood Hospital's closure in 2020 affected the community; current owner Medical Properties Trust invested $350 million in reconstruction.

title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A building collapse at 265 Dwight St. Ext. in Springfield displaced 45 people after severe thunderstorms and winds.
Mayor Domenic J. Sarno declared a state of emergency due to storms causing outages, downed trees, and power line failures.
The Red Cross and Eversource are assisting affected individuals, and power has been restored in impacted Springfield areas.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, reflecting on his 24-year NFL career.
In his speech, Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick's current role at UNC and the Patriots' Deflategate controversy.
Vinatieri expressed gratitude towards Patriots fans and teammates, highlighting the team's two-decade dynasty success.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old was struck and killed by a vehicle while biking in Williamstown on Friday at 5:40 p.m.
The incident occurred at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road with the child entering Main Street unexpectedly.
Officials report the driver was not impaired, no arrests made, and the investigation is ongoing.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials warn against swimming in Ames Pond after a dog died, suspecting an algae bloom.
Weekly E. Coli tests at Ames Pond haven't shown issues, but algae blooms are possible and risky.
Cyanobacterial algae blooms, which can rapidly form, can cause illnesses in humans and are deadly to pets.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: James Lamoureux, 43, a former NH State Trooper, pleaded guilty to making false reports about GPS tracking his girlfriend.
Lamoureux placed tracking devices on vehicles and falsely blamed others, leading to his six-month suspended sentence.
He resigned, surrendered his law enforcement certification, and will be placed on the national registry of decertified officers.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to a report of a man with a gun outside Grace Chapel but found no threat.
The man was polishing a musket-era powder horn, leading to a misunderstanding during the semiquincentennial celebrations.
The incident prompted a heavy police response, including building lockdown and road closures, but was resolved quickly.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox can maintain momentum for playoff qualification despite recent winning streak.
Red Sox hold the second A.L. wild-card spot with a record of 64-52, after winning 32 of their last 38 games.
FanGraphs gives Red Sox a 96% chance to make playoffs, with 83.4% chance for a wild-card spot and 12.6% for A.L. East title.
